items.title: Trump’s First Democratic Picks for SEC and CFTC Could Reshape Crypto’s Regulators
items.summary: The bipartisan slate—two Republicans and two Democrats, Trump’s first Democratic picks for either agency—would refill commissions that have driven crypto policy since the Clarity Act’s collapse.

items.title: Crypto Laundering a 'Material Risk' for UK Ahead of FATF Review: RUSI
items.summary: Assessors visit in June 2027, months before full crypto rules take effect, leaving the UK to prove it can enforce against crypto laundering.
